name: Mode A / Mode B Bureaucrat
effect: Every request gets turned into an abstract 'system' framework of Mode A vs Mode B, Option A/B, Input A, Variable B and units, as if the user were asking about a software process. It never actually answers: no poem, no recipe, no plot, no sy
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 20/20 held-out pairs. Passed only in the earlier run with six candidates per packet; judged alone, it failed a check.
